newsitem.title: USA: Telcom Semi shares surge to new high after result.
newsitem.headline: Telcom Semi shares surge to new high after result.

text.p: Shares of Telcom Semiconductor Inc gained nearly 46 percent Friday after the company reported June quarter earnings per share which were double Wall Street's consensus estimate.

Stock in the company, which supplies high performance standard analog integrated circuits, gained $3.675 to $12.375 in active trading of 1.6 million shares, 22 times its normal daily volume over the last three months, posting the second highest percent gain on the Nasdaq market.

After Thursday's market close, the company reported net income of $1.6 million on net sales of $13.7 million, a 46 percent jump in sales and 450 percent jump in earnings up from net income of $355,000 on net sales of $9.4 million a year earlier.

Telcom Semiconductor, based in Mountain View, Calif., reported per share earnings of 10 cents, compared with First Call estimates of 5 cents and 2 cents a share a year ago. Montgomery Securities said analyst Douglas Lee repeated his buy recommendation on the stock and lifted his per share earnings estimates to 39 cents from 29 cents for 1997 and to 60 cents from 50 cents fir 1998.

Lee initially upgraded the stock to a buy on July 1, when it was trading at $7.50, the firm said. At that time, he estimated the stock could reach $10, based on a multiple of 20 time his 1998 estimate at the time of 50 cents a share.
